blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Impeachment Court on Wednesday ruled that the voting threshold to convict Vice President Sara Duterte will depend on how many senator-judges are present during the trial. But how did the senator-judges vote? READ: Senate impeachment court lowers vote threshold to convict Sara Duterte Six senator-judges boycotted the voting proper after earlier asserting that the impeachment court should not decide how many votes are required to convict Duterte. These are Senator-judges Alan Peter Cayetano, Pia Cayetano, Imee Marcos, Christopher “Bong” Go, Camille Villar, and Robin Padilla.
